resources.string: Your parent is looking for you
Tap the button so your parent knows you heard it.
Tap to open, then tap I\'m here.
Your parent asked for the sound to keep going. It stops in %1$s.
Please answer before %1$s. If you have not answered by then, your location is sent to your parent once.
Your parent pressed Find, and your location was sent at %1$s.
You did not answer \"Are you okay?\", so your location was sent to your parent at %1$s.
Your location is shared with your parent
Every 5 minutes, until your parent turns it off.
Every 5 minutes, until %1$s. Then only when your parent presses Find or you do not answer \"Are you okay?\".
Your parent cannot see where you are. Location is off.
Your parent can see where you are only when they press Find. You get a notice each time.
Your parent can see where you are when they press Find, or if you do not answer \"Are you okay?\" in time. You get a notice each time.
Your location is shared every 5 minutes until %1$s. After that, only when your parent presses Find or you do not answer \"Are you okay?\".
Your location is shared every 5 minutes. You see this notice the whole time.
